The reality is – you're being asked to do more with less.

orBook a Call
Recruiters face a lot of problems. 
Speak_ can help.
There's never enough time.
Speak_ evaluates candidates asynchronously, saving you hours of sifting through unsorted resumes looking for the good ones.
Resume review is prone to bias.
You’ll remove the potential for unconscious bias by setting custom signals that teach our platform how to find the ideal candidate.
The resume pile is huge, but only a small percentage of them are qualified.
Our technology will screen every resume using your custom signals and find the most qualified candidates more efficiently.
Trusted by leading companies
Find your needle in a world of haystacks.
Set custom signals
You know better than anyone how to find the best candidates. Now you can teach AI to review resumes just like you.
Evaluate candidates async
At 90 seconds per resume, it takes a recruiter 25 hours to review 1000 resumes. With Speak_, you can evaluate candidates while you sleep.
Get in-depth insights
We'll tell you who's a match, who isn't, and why. See the highlights and lowlights of every candidate.
Accuracy matters
Find what you're really looking for
Describe the skills, experiences, and qualities that you're looking for in candidates. Tell the AI how important they are. We'll look through your applicants and find the best fits.
Easy and efficient
Lots of resumes? Don't worry.
We'll evaluate every candidate based on your custom criteria and put the best applicants at the top of the list.
Make better hires
Spend more time on what matters
You'll save over 20 hours per 1000 resumes. Use that time however you'd like.

Frequently asked questions
Have questions? We've got answers. For everything else email us at support@speak.careers.
How does Speak_ work?
➕
Speak_ uses AI to evaluate every applicant based on custom criteria (called "Signals") that you set.
Which applicant tracking systems (ATS) are you integrated with?
➕
We're currently integrated with Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, and Workable, with more integrations on the way.
Can I use Speak_ without an ATS?
➕
Yes, you can use Speak_ without an ATS. Simply add a job, set signals, and drop in resumes.
Where can I book a demo?
➕
We'd love to show you around! You can find an open time that works for you by clicking on this calendar link.
Do you have an affiliate program?
➕
Yes! Sign up to become an affiliate and earn a commission for every customer who signs up through your referral link.
